## 5. NEVER DO LIST

### Environment
- ❌ Never use `acme-app-prod` Firebase project in local development
- ❌ Never use Stripe live keys outside production
- ❌ Never commit `.env.local` or any file containing actual secrets
- ❌ Never create Firebase/Vercel/Supabase resources without explicit instruction

### Security (this app handles payments and user data)
- ❌ Never skip Firebase session cookie verification in the app layout
- ❌ Never trust client-provided user IDs for database queries — always use `request.auth.uid`
- ❌ Never process a Stripe webhook without validating the signature first
- ❌ Never expose `FIREBASE_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY` or `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` to the client
- ❌ Never use `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` without explicit sanitisation
- ❌ Never log passwords, tokens, card numbers, or PII

### Code
- ❌ Never use `any` in TypeScript
- ❌ Never leave `console.log` in production code (use `logger` from `src/lib/logger.ts`)
- ❌ Never import from `src/lib/firebase-admin.ts` in a client component (build will fail)
- ❌ Never import from `src/lib/stripe.ts` in a client component (build will fail)
- ❌ Never hardcode colours, font sizes, or spacing — use design tokens

---

## 6. ALWAYS DO LIST

### Before writing any code
- ✅ Read this file
- ✅ Run `git status` — confirm branch
- ✅ Run `node scripts/verify-env.js local` — confirm environment is correct
- ✅ Check `src/lib/env.ts` — all new environment variables must be added here

### Authentication pattern
- ✅ All authenticated routes live in `src/app/(app)/`
- ✅ The `(app)/layout.tsx` verifies the Firebase session cookie on every request
- ✅ API routes verify authentication before processing any request
- ✅ Database queries always filter by user ID — never query all records

### Payments
- ✅ Always use `src/lib/stripe.ts` (server-only) — never the client SDK for server operations
- ✅ Always validate Stripe webhook signatures in `src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts`
- ✅ Always make webhook handlers idempotent — check if the event was already processed

### Finishing a task
- ✅ `pnpm type-check && pnpm lint && pnpm test:unit`
- ✅ Update `docs/TECH_DEBT.md` for any compromise
- ✅ Write to `docs/AGENT_HANDOFF.md`

---

## 7. ARCHITECTURE DECISIONS

See `docs/adr/` for all decisions. Key ones:

- **ADR-001:** Firebase Auth + session cookies (not JWT in localStorage)
- **ADR-002:** Supabase for relational data + Firestore for user-scoped documents
- **ADR-003:** Stripe Checkout Sessions (not Payment Intents) for initial implementation

---

## 8. ASKING FOR HELP

Stop and ask when:
- Uncertain which environment you are in
- About to modify Firebase Security Rules or Supabase RLS policies
- About to run a database migration
- About to touch Stripe webhook handling
- About to do anything in production
